title: App State Move-In & Boone NC Student Housing 2026
excerpt: App State move-in weekend is here, and Boone is buzzing with students, families, and U-Hauls on every block. If you're a parent watching your student settle into another year of renting, it might be time to ask whether buying a home in Boone NC makes more sense for your family.
